name: Wald Wire & Manufacturing Co
old_description: We understand your need to have the most reliable and flexible supply chain partners so you can meet your customers’ demands. Additionally, you shouldn’t have to compromise on results, including delivery times, quantities and quality. Our 75 years of experience and our centralized Wisconsin-based location ensure you have the flexibility for fast turnarounds, short runs and immediate shipping.
about:
Wald Wire & Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1951 in Oshkosh, Wisconsin, as a small wire-forming shop serving small and midsize manufacturers in the Northeast Wisconsin region. The company remains headquartered in Oshkosh and has grown from a 9,000-square-foot facility with a handful of employees to a multi-shop operation.

Today the company operates over 200,000 square feet across three shops and employs more than 100 people. Its core capabilities include CNC 2D and 3D wire forming, spot welding, stamping, rolled and cut threads, in-house toolmaking, and tube and sheet metal fabrication with laser cutting, forming, and rolling. The wire-forming robotics produce items such as shelving, racks, baskets, fan guards, and pegboards in a wide range of metal materials.

Wald Wire serves both small-to-midsize manufacturers and Fortune 500 companies, offering no quantity minimums, fast turnarounds, and immediate shipping for short or long production runs. Customers rely on the shop for individual components, full assemblies, and end-to-end fulfillment.

The company emphasizes a “flexible, fully-integrated supply chain partner” model, promising “unbending results” through a relentless commitment to delivering quality welding, wire, tube, and sheet metal fabrication within the promised timeline.
